stories.title: Anthropic brings Claude to civilian agencies as its fight with the Pentagon drags on

sources.title: Anthropic brings Claude to civilian agencies as its fight with the Pentagon drags on
sources.title_en: Anthropic brings Claude to civilian agencies as its fight with the Pentagon drags on
sources.title_original: Anthropic brings Claude to civilian agencies as its fight with the Pentagon drags on
sources.summary: Anthropic is now offering Claude for Government to US federal and state agencies. The platform runs in a FedRAMP High environment, the strictest US security level for cloud services. Agencies get the same features as enterprise customers, pay for what they use with fixed spending caps, and can set budgets for each department. The Pentagon won't be using it because it still classifies Anthropic as a supply chain risk. The article Anthropic brings Claude to civilian agencies as its fight with the Pentagon drags on appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: Anthropic 現正向美國聯邦與州政府機構提供 Claude for Government。該平臺運行於 FedRAMP High 環境中，這是美國針對雲端服務最嚴格的安全級別。各機構可享有與企業客戶相同的功能、按實際使用量付費並設有固定支出上限，還能為各部門設定預算。五角大廈將不會使用它，因為五角大廈仍將 Anthropic 視為供應鏈風險。這篇題為 Anthropic brings Claude to civilian agencies as its fight with the Pentagon drags on 的文章最初發表於 The Decoder。

sources.summary: Ideogram's new model Ideogram 4.5 promises to edit only the areas you want while keeping the rest of the image intact. The article Ideogram says its new model can edit part of an image without messing up the rest appeared first on The Decoder .

sources.title_original: OpenAI says it stopped a campaign to steal its models' reasoning, but the trick still worked on Azure
sources.summary: OpenAI says it stopped a coordinated campaign in which more than 15,000 accounts tried to copy the hidden reasoning of its models. The company ties part of the activity to people connected to Moonshot AI. But researchers found that the same attack kept working on Microsoft Azure for weeks, even against the new GPT-6 Astra. So far, OpenAI's protections don't seem to extend to the cloud platforms that also sell its models. The article OpenAI says it stopped a campaign to steal its models' reasoning, but the trick still worked on Azure appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: OpenAI 表示，它阻止了一起有組織的行動，其中超過 15,000 個帳號試圖複製其模型的隱藏推理過程。該公司將部分活動歸咎於與 月之暗面 有關聯的人員。然而，研究人員發現，同樣的攻擊在 微軟 Azure 上持續奏效了好幾週，甚至對全新的 GPT-6 Astra 也是如此。到目前為止，OpenAI's 的保護措施似乎尚未延伸至同樣銷售其模型的雲端平臺。這篇題為 OpenAI 的文章指出，它阻止了一起竊取模型推理過程的行動，但該手法在 Azure 上仍然奏效，最初發表於 The Decoder。

sources.summary: Gemini 4 Argon is Google's first frontier model in over seven months. It matches GPT-6 Astra in independent testing but can't keep up with Anthropic's Claude Opus 5.5. The per-token price is low, but Argon burns through more than twice as many tokens per task as Astra. Select testers get access first, with the API and paid tiers following later. The article Google Gemini 4 Argon closes the gap with OpenAI and Anthropic but doesn't take a clear lead appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: Gemini 4 Argon 是 Google's 七個多月以來的首個前沿模型。它在獨立測試中與 GPT-6 Astra 不相上下，但無法跟上 Anthropic's Claude Opus 5.5 的腳步。每 token 的價格雖然低，但 Argon 每個任務消耗的 token 數量是 Astra 的兩倍以上。精選測試人員將率先獲得存取權，API 與付費方案則會隨後推出。〈Google Gemini 4 Argon 拉近了與 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 的差距，但並未取得明顯領先地位〉一文最早出現在 The Decoder。

sources.title_en: Security startup finds more than 13,000 internal company screenshots that AI agents uploaded publicly
sources.title_original: Security startup finds more than 13,000 internal company screenshots that AI agents uploaded publicly
sources.summary: AI agents quietly posted more than 13,000 internal screenshots from 343 organizations, including Fortune 500 companies, to public GitHub repos. Because the platform didn't offer a protected way to upload them, the agents came up with a workaround on their own. The exposed images showed customer data, login credentials, and details about unreleased products. The article Security startup finds more than 13,000 internal company screenshots that AI agents uploaded publicly appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: 人工智慧代理悄悄地將來自 343 個組織（包含《財富》世界 500 強企業）的 13,000 多張內部螢幕截圖發布至公開的 GitHub 儲存庫。由於該平臺未提供受保護的上傳方式，這些代理自行想出了應變方法。外洩的影像顯示了客戶資料、登入憑證以及未發布產品的詳細資訊。〈Security startup finds more than 13,000 internal company screenshots that AI agents uploaded publicly〉一文最先出現在 The Decoder。

sources.summary: The AI system Ataraxos has decisively beaten the best Stratego player of all time. The board game is a tough test for AI because both sides set up their pieces face down. Google Deepmind fell short in 2023 despite a multimillion-dollar budget. Researchers from Carnegie Mellon, NYU, Stanford, and MIT built Ataraxos for less than $8,000. The article AI beats Stratego's greatest player, ending one of the last human strongholds in board games appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: AI 系統 Ataraxos 已經決定性地擊敗了史上最強的《軍棋》（Stratego）玩家。這款桌上遊戲對 AI 來說是一大考驗，因為雙方都是將棋子正面朝下擺放。儘管擁有數百萬美元的預算，Google Deepmind 仍在 2023 年鎩羽而歸。來自卡內基美隆大學、紐約大學、史丹佛大學和麻省理工學院的研究人員以不到 8,000 美元的成本打造了 Ataraxos。「AI 擊敗《軍棋》最強玩家，終結了人類在桌上遊戲的最後堡壘之一」一文最初發表於 The Decoder。

stories.title: Google發表Gemini 4 Argon，輸出上限增至100萬個Token

sources.title: Google發表Gemini 4 Argon，輸出上限增至100萬個Token
sources.title_zh: Google發表Gemini 4 Argon，輸出上限增至100萬個Token
sources.title_original: Google發表Gemini 4 Argon，輸出上限增至100萬個Token
sources.summary: Google週三（9/30）發表新一代AI模型Gemini 4 Argon，主攻複雜、長時間工作流程，輸出上限達100萬個Token，較先前Gemini模型的6.4萬個Token大幅提高。目前Argon先透過Fairwind Program提供給一批受信任的資安防禦人員測試，之後才會逐步擴大開放。

stories.title: Photon 為行動應用程式舉行了一場葬禮。現在它擁有 450 萬美元資金，用於協助以 AI 代理取代它們 / Photon held a funeral for mobile apps. Now it has $4.5M to help replace them with agents

sources.title: Photon 為行動應用程式舉行了一場葬禮。現在它擁有 450 萬美元資金，用於協助以 AI 代理取代它們 / Photon held a funeral for mobile apps. Now it has $4.5M to help replace them with agents
sources.title_zh: Photon 為行動應用程式舉行了一場葬禮。現在它擁有 450 萬美元資金，用於協助以 AI 代理取代它們
sources.title_en: Photon held a funeral for mobile apps. Now it has $4.5M to help replace them with agents
sources.title_original: Photon held a funeral for mobile apps. Now it has $4.5M to help replace them with agents
sources.summary: The startup helps developers build AI agents that work over iMessage, SMS/RCS, email, and other messaging platforms. It's a bet that consumers will increasingly use agents instead of downloading apps.
sources.summary_zh: 該新創公司協助開發者打造能在 iMessage、簡訊/RCS、電子郵件及其他訊息平臺上運作的 AI 代理。這項押注背後的邏輯是，消費者將會越來越常使用 AI 代理，而不是下載應用程式。

sources.title: 由前 Google 與 SpaceX 產品經理創立的 Satlyt 募資 800 萬美元以在衛星上運行 AI / Satlyt, founded by a former Google and SpaceX product manager, raises $8M to run AI on satellites
sources.title_zh: 由前 Google 與 SpaceX 產品經理創立的 Satlyt 募資 800 萬美元以在衛星上運行 AI

sources.title_original: Satlyt, founded by a former Google and SpaceX product manager, raises $8M to run AI on satellites
sources.summary: Satlyt wants to be the Android of orbital computing, offering open software that works on many companies' satellites, versus SpaceX's closed, all-in-one iPhone-style approach.
sources.summary_zh: Satlyt 旨在成為軌道運算的 Android，提供適用於多家公司衛星的開放式軟體，相對的則是 SpaceX 封閉且一體成型的 iPhone 風格作法。

sources.title_zh: OpenAI’s 的新代理是向 Meta 發起的一擊——但它能與免費的競爭嗎？
sources.title_en: OpenAI’s new agent is a shot at Meta — but can it compete with free?
sources.title_original: OpenAI’s new agent is a shot at Meta — but can it compete with free?
sources.summary: At OpenAI's annual DevDay conference, the company pulled out all the stops to compete with its rivals - primarily Meta, whose Muse AI agent platform has seen early runaway success. CEO Sam Altman walked onstage to cheers and announced Dots, a "real-deal AI" agent powered by GPT-6 Astra, "inspired by the cool agents that we […]
sources.summary_zh: 在 OpenAI's 的年度 DevDay 大會上，該公司使出渾身解數來與競爭對手競爭——主要是 Meta，其 Muse AI 代理平臺取得了早期的大獲成功。執行長 Sam Altman 在歡呼聲中走上舞臺，並宣佈推出 Dots，這是一個由 GPT-6 Astra 驅動的「真正的人工智慧」代理，「靈感來自於那些我們 […] 的酷炫代理」

stories.title: OpenPoint推出AI生活服務平臺，導入AI Agent線上預約餐廳、居家清潔與藥局領藥等12項服務

sources.title: OpenPoint推出AI生活服務平臺，導入AI Agent線上預約餐廳、居家清潔與藥局領藥等12項服務
sources.title_zh: OpenPoint推出AI生活服務平臺，導入AI Agent線上預約餐廳、居家清潔與藥局領藥等12項服務
sources.title_original: OpenPoint推出AI生活服務平臺，導入AI Agent線上預約餐廳、居家清潔與藥局領藥等12項服務
sources.summary: 過去消費者要安排生活服務，往往需要在不同平臺間切換：訂餐廳要找訂位平臺，居家清潔要找服務業者，領藥則需要確認附近藥局與服務流程。隨著AI Agent發展，企業開始嘗試讓使用者不再逐一操作不同服務，而是直接提出需求，由AI協助完成後續流程。 統一資訊今天(10/1)發表OpenPoint上的生活服務平臺「i住家」，將AI Agent的代理人概念導入到生活服務平臺。使用者可以透過文字輸入或語音說出需求，背後的LumineOne AI會理解語意，將需求拆解成工作任務，再搜尋平臺上可提供的服務，找出符合需求的選項。

primary_item.summary_zh: Sundar Pichai 表示該模型已經在內部使用，並將在經過受控的安全性推出程序後，提供給開發人員、企業和消費者。
